snippet.title: Last Call FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Last Call By Monty ENDING 1 WELCOME TO PALE MOON CITY Horror Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Pale Moon City is cursed, or so they say. Ghosts, demons, angels, cults, if you've seen it in a horror movie, someone has seen it in Pale Moon City. It's a city that loves horror, and horror loves Pale Moon right back.

Last Call: https://deepseahorror.itch.io/last-call
Developer: Monty
Genres: Horror, RPG
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
